description: Read the state, payload, states, allowed transitions and history of a handoff with either token. wait_seconds, up to 25, waits for the state to change or the handoff to end before answering. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

handoff_id.description: The handoff_id returned at creation; not a credential.

token.description: The owner_token or the receiver_token returned once at creation. Both read and advance; the history records which one acted.

name: read_agent_handoff
title: Read an agent handoff
